learning_outcomes.text: Students have profound knowledge of advanced methods of engineering mathematics and their applications in engineering. They can differentiate between the areas of application.

Students understand the learned mathematical procedures in their methodological context and can, in individual cases, break down complex solution methods into individual steps and combine them in a structured way to form a complete solution. They can describe the relevance of the methods for engineering tasks.

Students can analyze and classify standard mathematical procedures in engineering and computer science. They can describe, problem-oriented select, and solve simple subject-specific problems using mathematical methods.

syllabus_topics: Integral calculus of functions of one variable
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are as per the currently valid study regulations.
